# Staff of Frost

Internal ID: StaffIceShards | Type: Elemental magic | Source: Galdr table | Usage: Magic weapon | Crafting Materials: Yggdrasil wood x30, Freeze gland x6, Refined eitr x24 | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Staff of Frost is one of four Magic weapons introduced in the Mistlands update. Its primary attack fires freezing shards of ice at a rapid pace with low accuracy. While its poor accuracy limits the staff's effective range severely, the freezing effect slows any enemies hit by the attack. This allows even small and fast enemies to be hit repeatedly and kept at a distance.
The staff's damage and eitr usage are dependent on the caster's Elemental magic skill level. Like the other magic weapons, it has no secondary attack.
Wet enemies are vulnerable to Frost damage and will take increased damage from the staff.

Total cost for the fully upgraded staff: 80 Yggdrasil wood, 16 Freeze gland, 64 Refined eitr

## Notes

• The head of the staff glows faintly light-blue at all times. It is a bit dimmer than most proper light sources, but it can provide some light in the dark.
• The glow effect also makes players slightly easier to detect while sneaking, increasing the visibility of its holder by approximately 20%.

## Trivia

• The staff's description refers to Fimbulvetr, the (possibly volcanic) Winter that was said to be the first stage of Ragnarok.
